decision.if: gbrain-section beats gbrain-default on H4 for claude-opus-5-5 (primary interval above 0) and the other four families show no harm (pooled lower bound above -5 points, a fixed margin)
decision.then: the default flip of search.long_page_unit to section goes to Garry, through GBRA-108, with these numbers

decision.if: section delivery helps on H4 but harm on the other families is not ruled out
decision.then: the flip does not go to Garry as it stands; GBRA-108 gets the per-family split as evidence for a scoped version

decision.if: the primary difference is not distinguishable from 0
decision.then: the flip is closed; one Why-null cycle records why, with a KEEP (as an opt-in setting), FIX-METHOD or CUT-CANDIDATE verdict

decision.if: section delivery hurts on H4 (primary interval below 0)
decision.then: the flip is closed, and GBRA-108 gets the paired numbers

decision.if: gbrain-section is ahead of files on H4 (gap interval above 0)
decision.then: README says gbrain with section delivery answers more of these questions than plain files, with the interval

decision.if: gbrain-section is level with files on H4
decision.then: README says gbrain with section delivery is level with plain files on these questions, with the interval

decision.if: gbrain-section is still behind files on H4, or the gap is not distinguishable
decision.then: README gives the gap with its interval, and the manager-phrase share of the misses goes to GBRA-108
